description: Self-hosted Renovate config for the Forgejo origin. Full rationale and the maintainer activation steps live in docs/renovate.md (spike #58).
INERT until the maintainer creates a renovate-bot PAT, sets the RENOVATE_TOKEN secret, and enables .forgejo/workflows/renovate.yml. No token means no runs and no pull requests.

Manages gomod, npm, and GitHub-Actions-style action pins (the github-actions manager already covers .github/, .gitea/ and .forgejo/ workflows by default). It deliberately does NOT manage manifest/dotf.lock, which is owned by 'dotf lock'.

packageRules.description: Force the conventional-commit type 'chore' for every dependency update so commits satisfy commitlint (type-enum) and stay out of release notes. Overrides the fix-for-runtime-deps rule pulled in by config:recommended.
Group non-major npm dev-dependency bumps (linters, commit hooks, tsx) into a single low-noise pull request.
